name: Angel Winters
source: The Earth is being invaded by a race of powerful angels. One of those angels, Gabriella, has chosen the Arctic as the first target for conversion, but finds unexpected resistance in the form of a dragon girl named Sera. Thus begins the first of their many, many fights.
translation: 地球正在被强大的天使种族入侵。其中一位天使加布里埃拉选择了北极作为第一个皈依目标，但却发现了一个名叫塞拉的龙女的意外抵抗。他们许许多多的战斗中的第一场就这样开始了。
